issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect make_y_state to accept a depolarization strength parameter p (signature: make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None), but the template's make_y_state is declared without the p parameter (def make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int) -> None). This mismatch will prevent students from implementing and testing noisy |Y> state preparation as specified, and will cause tests that call make_y_state(circ, q, p) to fail or confuse students about the required signature.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template function signature to include the depolarization probability parameter p, matching the problem statement and solution: def make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None. Update the function docstring to document the p parameter. This keeps the template consistent with the exercise specification and the reference solution.
